In detail

Repeated targeted searches for Butarque specifically returned only general Villaverde-district narcopiso/robbery coverage (centred on San Cristobal, Villaverde Alto and Los Rosales) with no article naming Butarque itself as the location of an incident -- several results were explicitly flagged by the search engine as not matching the barrio name. No particular safety concern found in the source review specific to this barrio. Sources checked: Google search for 'Butarque Villaverde Madrid narcopiso/inseguridad/robos': results returned were district-wide, none Butarque-specific.

Frequently asked questions

Is Butarque safe?

Wandroz rates Butarque in Madrid as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Madrid. That rating rests on an area-level review that reached no traveller-relevant reporting specific to Butarque — no incidents, no recurring problems, nothing documented either way — read together with the character of the area. It is not a positive finding of safety: an absence of reporting is weaker evidence than the sourced ratings elsewhere on this map, and it is marked as such wherever it appears.

What was checked for Butarque?

The same area-level review every other neighbourhood on the Madrid map gets: local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist, searched for this specific area. Butarque returned nothing traveller-relevant, which is common for smaller administrative areas without a press profile of their own. Where a review does return something, the sources are named on the area's page.

Is Butarque a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Nothing documented argues against it. For a stay, weigh that against the areas on the Madrid map whose ratings are backed by named sources, and check recent reviews for the specific street. You can search accommodation already scoped to this area using the Booking.com link on this page.
